artists.purpose: artist technique research metadata, NOT an AI training dataset

artist.name: TofuPxl
artist.specialty: pixel art environments, vegetation, game backgrounds, modular tilesets, portrait studies
artist.primary_focus: limited-palette character portraits + game environment construction

works.title: 4 4 colour portraits
works.source_evidence: PixelJoint explicitly lists Palette: 4 colors; work description: studies in a limited palette for practice
research_points: 同一四色下不同脸型、角度与肤色的辨识能力
通过色块边界表达鼻梁、下颌、眉骨与眼窝
发束大轮廓和阴影区域的层级分配
四种颜色跨角色共用，而不是每个人各取四种

works.title: portrait 2
works.source_evidence: PixelJoint gallery caption: weekly portrait club; no palette count established
research_points: 头部结构和微表情的精致像素组织
发束亮暗与面部边缘的语义化像素

works.title: fallen
research_points: 对比4色与32色肖像如何组织脸部体积
检查是否因为颜色增加而引入噪点；不预设高色数更好

works.title: Field — Book of Abominations
works.source_evidence: PixelJoint describes second battle background; UI by Alex De La Cour
research_points: 自然草地与前景植物的轮廓和空间层次
背景尺度、自然材料色块分区、地表与景深
场景素材研发，不将UI设计归属误记给Tofu

works.title: Modular Tileset
works.source_evidence: Portfolio Games section explicitly lists Modular Tileset
research_points: 可重复使用的独立地面与建筑模块
图块连接处形状、比例一致性与层级解耦

rights.permission_basis: Public portfolio visibility is not license to train; PixelJoint states all copyright retained by artists.
rights.preview_policy: link-to-source only; remote previews are not copied to repo

style_hypotheses: 轮廓优先于次要纹理，四种色值均承担明确结构语义
以块面而非散点塑造立体五官与发型
在四种颜色中保持人物肤色/姿态差异
环境模块与人物肖像的色彩分组原则可迁移，但同一个作品是否只用四色须分开确认
limitations: 仅明确核实2021年的四肖像作品为四色，不能概括作者所有作品四色
作者原作品的四个精确HEX值尚未核验，不会伪造
仅分析公开作品及作者自述，不下载或机器训练其图片
Anima是否识别@tofupxl标签未核实，不加入正式prompt
